assay: bulk RNA-seq of left ventricle (Illumina NovaSeq 6000, Salmon v1.10.2 on GRCm38, gene-level DESeq2 1.40.2) (S4.9.p1)
sample_inclusion: control (chow null), DIO (HFD null), hypertensive (chow Renin), HFpEF (HFD Renin), n = 5-6 per group (S2.4.p1, FIG4); GEO has 21 samples (4/6/6/5)
primary_estimand: Effect of the two-hit HFD-Renin (HFpEF) condition and of each driver (HFD, AAV-Renin) on the LV transcriptome versus chow null controls. No exercise intervention exists in the sequenced samples: exercise appears only as a phenotyping readout (treadmill test to exhaustion, S2.2.p4, S4.5.p1, FIG2H) on separate whole-animal measurements, not as a sequenced arm.
planned_contrasts: HFD null vs chow null (DIO effect; S2.4.p1: 839 downregulated DEGs at adjusted p < 0.01; Supp Fig S4A)
chow Renin vs chow null (hypertension effect; S2.4.p1: 927 upregulated DEGs; Supp Fig S4B)
HFD Renin vs chow null (HFpEF; S2.4.p1/FIG4C: 498 up, 472 down)
paper_method: DESeq2 1.40.2 on Salmon gene-level counts, pairwise conditions of interest (S4.9.p1)

paper_threshold.note: FDR < 0.05 and at least 1.2-fold change up or down: |log2FC| >= log2(1.2) = 0.2630344; S2.4.p1 quotes adjusted p < 0.01 for the DIO count
